name: bird-flight
description: Bird Flight, a one-tap flying game for Android built with Vite and Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.deploy: npm run build && ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb -s R3CT50BYRVY install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb -s R3CT50BYRVY shell am start -n com.example.htmlgames/.MainActivity
